title: Introduction to Computer Science homework
summary: Students solve introductory computer science homework questions. ChatGPT was tested offline on the same questions and achieved performance comparable to students, indicating substantial exposure if external AI use is uncontrolled.

sources.title: Rethinking Homework in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
